text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's finally starting. Our hot springs retreat period!

"Two days before the hot spring trip.
Hishi Miracle showed up at the Trainer's office full of life."
choice_data_list: Though the hot spring itself is really only for one day
The hot spring itself is really only for one day, though

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no. There's a slight chance
it might get extended, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Mirako needs more recuperation..."
Thinking that, Trainer-san paid extra just for me—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, where's the sharp retort?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Where's the sharp, butt-kicking remark
I was expecting?
choice_data_list: No, I can give you extra time off if you need it, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: Your health comes first, after all.
Your health comes first, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ehh? But then, that wouldn't even be a joke anymore!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even before the hot springs trip, when I asked for two days off,
they actually gave them to me without hesitation.
choice_data_list: That was the deal, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to take a huge break, okay~?
I'm gonna savor every last bit of being lazy~!
And on the day of the hot springs trip—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, tatami smells so nice~.
Today, this place is my castle~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer,
are you heading back to your room already?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "No, no... If we do that, it's kinda... hmm."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh right,
what time was dinner again?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sukiyaki and crab hot pot.
Bamboo shoot rice, plus matsutake chawanmushi~♪
choice_data_list: I think it was around 6:00 PM.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, seems we might have a chance
to hit the hot springs before that.
choice_data_list: Yeah, go enjoy it to your heart's content.
Yeah, go ahead and enjoy it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, all you ever think about
is making sure I rest, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, you're way too serious.
Even though we finally got to come here together.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaah... I feel like I'm gonna melt...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...'This hot spring is said to be effective
for neuralgia, muscle pain, and fatigue recovery.'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I mean... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Health," huh...
(Squeeeak...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Damn. Hot, it's a sauna...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(No, I don't care how good it is for your health,
there's no way I can take this. If I stay here for 10 minutes—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaahh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I'll leave in five minutes!
I'll leave in five minutes!
I'll leave in five minutes!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... My head feels so light and floaty~...
Haaah~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's so cool outside...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fuhe~,
my body is still all warm and toasty~.
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle! How was the hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I tried going to a sauna.
Detox complete, and my skin is super bouncy and glowing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Compared to your strict training,
Trainer, this sauna felt lukewarm.
choice_data_list: Then should we look for an even hotter sauna?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nope!
It means your usual training is just a wee bit too strict, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So today, please go full-on carrot and no stick.
In both your words and actions.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you want, you could treat me to some ice cream!
Even though it's not dinner time yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
It really pays off to ask~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...This is my Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Serious, strict, and sometimes sweet.
And just a tiny bit... completely outrageous.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (She gave me the courage to jump straight into the heat when I was just soaking in lukewarm water—she's truly amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: *nibble*... *munch*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, so cold~♪
This ice cream is super sweet~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
......Hm-hm.
Listen here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't mind pushing myself
a bit harder, you know. Starting tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it gets a little tough,
I'll keep up with you."

It was a moment where I felt an
irreplaceable bond with Hishi Miracle...
